top_signals.title: CoreWeave’s market confidence erodes as bond yields spike and stock sinks
top_signals.summary: CoreWeave shares are down 29% in October, and the spreads in its credit default swaps are widening.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Potential liquidity or banking-system instability affecting financial conditions.

top_signals.title: Silver Flows Back Into India as Import Curbs Ease Before Diwali
top_signals.summary: India’s silver imports are set to rebound in time for the busiest jewelry-buying season after the government issued a raft of new permits, easing restrictions that had stifled shipments to one of the world’s biggest markets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: South Korea’s crypto bill nears completion while tax debate intensifies: reports
top_signals.summary: The bill seeks to establish a framework for digital assets, including licensing regimes for exchanges and rules for stablecoin issuance.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
